summary: Examples validate simple and complex URLs, including an FTP URL with credentials, and show mailto checks with the uri test.
questions: Is an FTP URL with credentials a valid URL?
How do I check a simple http URL?

answer_card.title: url test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ 'http://example.com' is url }}                                  # True
{{ 'ftp://admin:secret@example.com/path/to/myfile.yml' is url }}   # True
{{ 'mailto://nowone@example.com' is not uri(schemes=['ftp','ftps','sftp','file']) }}
```
